prompt:
Scene:
A square-format photograph of the same mall atrium, same camera vantage as the reference. Now the image implicitly foregrounds the central planter's lower basin, which has been revealed to be a shallow fountain currently turned off. 90s direct on-camera flash hits the empty fountain basin. Ambient is a low warm glow from security lights above. 35mm grain, slight warm cast.

Subject:
The same atrium footprint: terrazzo floor, planter with faux ficus, wooden benches around, escalator pair in the back, balcony railings above. The planter centerpiece is reframed so the viewer sees that its base is a round shallow fountain basin, drained of water, with scattered coins settled on the tile bottom and a small pump nozzle sticking up dry. The wooden benches and ficus remain in place. Storefronts along the sides remain shuttered.

Important details:
Fountain basin must read as dry — no residual water sheen except trace puddles around coins. Coins must be generic currency-blob shapes, not identifiable denominations. Preserve everything else from the reference: camera height, planter location, balcony geometry, storefront spacing. The mood is 'wish-coins with no active fountain to receive them'. No shopper, no security, no photographer reflection in any trace water.

Use case:
Series image 3 of 4. Same atrium, fountain turned off.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no identifiable currency design, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no people, no active water, no cinematic grade.
